subject: Hosted API integration: architecture deep-dive — scheduling & reschedule
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@therahealth.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.fields@therahealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the earlier overview. Marcus and I would like to schedule a focused technical session to walk our infra and app teams through: SDK integration patterns, streaming responses and reconnect/latency behavior, and recommended approaches to tool/function calling for our clinical workflows. Goal is to validate feasibility and identify any blockers before procurement.

Could you propose a 60–75 minute slot next week with an agenda and any pre-read? We anticipate inviting: 2 backend engineers, 1 security engineer, 1 PM.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Platform Lead, TheraHealth

---
Attachment: requirements-placeholder.csv (stub - list of TheraHealth endpoints)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@therahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear ask.

We can run a 75-minute architecture deep-dive that covers: 1) SDK quickstart & recommended client patterns, 2) streaming behavior (latency profiles, reconnect strategies, KV/cache considerations), 3) function/tool calling design patterns and security boundaries, and 4) rollback/fallback routing for availability.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue 23 Mar, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 24 Mar, 14:00–15:15
- Thu 25 Mar, 09:00–10:15

I'll attach a short draft agenda and a network checklist for the streaming demo. Can you confirm which slot works for Marcus and the engineers? Also, please share any non-prod endpoints we should use for the live demo (or we can demo against our sandbox).

Agenda (high level) attached: redwood-hosted-deepdive-agenda.pdf
Network checklist attached: network-checklist.txt

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0194

---
Attachment: redwood-hosted-deepdive-agenda.pdf (3 pages)
Attachment: network-checklist.txt (1 page)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@therahealth.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Sarah — FYI team availability updated. Marcus noted Wed afternoon would be best. We penciled Wed 24 Mar, 14:00–15:15 PDT.

A few pre-reads that would speed the session up if you can share ahead of time:
- sample payloads and expected concurrency per-second
- any IP allowlists / egress restrictions
- whether you need on-prem adapters for tool calls (we've done reverse-proxy patterns)

If you prefer, we can run the streaming demo against our sandbox and then walk through what changes when you switch to your non-prod environment.

Thanks — I'll send the calendar invite once Sarah confirms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Developer Experience, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@therahealth.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Quick note before we lock the invite — we should cover these technical pre-reqs in the session and flag any blockers live:
- SDK auth patterns (API key rotation + short-lived creds) and demo of token refresh flow
- Streaming: expected maximum concurrent connections, average token rates, and the client's retry/backoff behavior; will demo a client reconnect scenario
- Tool calling: define VPC egress patterns and discuss how to limit callable actions via RBAC at the model layer

Also — I have a conflict in the afternoon on 24th and will need to join the first 30 minutes only; Ava can cover the streaming demo end-to-end.

Karthik
Principal Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@therahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Fields <m.fields@therahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs + streaming + tool calls)

Thanks, everyone — Wed 24 Mar 14:00–15:15 PDT works for us. Marcus asked that you send the calendar invite with the dial-in and a link to the sandbox endpoints.

One small change: our security engineer will be on travel the 24th afternoon and asked if we can move the session to Fri 26 Mar 10:00–11:15 PDT instead. Is that possible for the Redwood team? If Karthik has a conflict, Ava covering streaming is fine.

If Friday works, please update the invite and call out the following pre-reqs in the calendar description so our security engineer can glance prior to the meeting: attach network-checklist.txt and list sandbox URLs.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Platform Lead, TheraHealth
